en:
Kaede didn't use the shot put ball
at the scene of the crime...

She used it at the <CLT=cltSTRONG>1st floor classroom<CLT=cltNORMAL>,
where we were keeping watch!

Hold up. How could she have hit Rantaro
with a shot from a different floor?

She rolled the shot from the 1st floor
classroom and hit Rantaro.

I am skeptical that she could perform
such a feat of accuracy...

So it was a magic shot put ball?
Nyeh. That's not possible.

If you do it at the <CLT=cltSTRONG>right spot<CLT=cltNORMAL> in the
classroom, it will reach the library.
So it seems...you already knew about that...

<CLT=cltMIND>I didn't want to figure it out...
I didn't want to know...

<CLT=cltMIND>But...I can't turn
away from the truth...

<CLT=cltMIND>The place she rolled the shot put ball
to move it from the classroom to the library...
